name: Reinhold Wuerth
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2012-2025); Hurun Global (2024)
forbes_bio: Reinhold Wuerth is honorary chairman of the supervisory board of the Wuerth Group, a German hardware manufacturer founded by his father.
Wuerth joined the family's wholesale screw business in 1949, at age 14, as the company's second employee and first apprentice.
Today, with annual sales of over $23 billion, the Wuerth Group has more than 400 companies and 86,000 employees around the world.
Wuerth retired in 1994; his nephew Sebastian Wuerth now serves as chairman of the advisory board of Wuerth Group.
forbes_facts: Wuerth's vast art collection, consisting of more than 20,000 pieces, began with an Emil Nolde watercolor painting acquired in 1972.
An avid aviator, Wuerth was president of a German flying club for nearly 25 years.

name: Sandra Ortega Mera
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Wikidata (2025)
forbes_bio: Sandra Ortega Mera is the daughter of Amancio Ortega, cofounder of clothing giant Inditex, known for its Zara retail chain.
She inherited her fortune from her mother, Rosalia Mera (d. 2013), who cofounded Inditex with Amancio Ortega in the 1970's.
Now the second-richest person in Spain after her father, Sandra holds roughly a 4.5% stake in Inditex, but she is not involved in the company.
She devotes her time to Fundación Paideia, the nonprofit her mother started that supports vocational training for people with disabilities.
She owns a 4.5% stake in publicly traded pharma company PharmaMar, which specializes in anticancer drugs.
forbes_facts: She holds a psychology degree from the Universidad de Santiago.
She lives a private life in the Galician town of La Coruña with her husband and three kids.

name: Francine von Finck
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Francine von Finck and her 4 children inherited their fortune from her late husband and their father, August von Finck, who died at 91 in Nov. 2021.
August inherited a business started by his grandfather, Wilhelm von Finck, in 1870.
August's Merck Finck & Co. private bank spawned the Loewenbraeu breweries and insurers Munich Re and Allianz.
August sold Merck Finck and the Allianz shares to Barclays Bank in 1990 and reinvested the money in a diverse portfolio.

name: Frank Lowy
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1997-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: An era ended in 2018 when Frank Lowy sold his Westfield Corp. to a Franco-Dutch group Unibail-Rodamco in a $16 billion deal that was Australia's largest takeover at the time.
A Holocaust survivor, Lowy opened his first shopping center in Sydney in 1959, launching what became one of the world's largest mall businesses.
Today the Lowys' main business is running their family investment house, Lowy Family Group, with offices in New York, Los Angeles and Sydney.
Lowy is a principal of the group, along with his three sons, David, Peter and Steven.
forbes_facts: Lowy is chairman of the Lowy Institute, an Australian think-tank he founded in 2023.
Lowy's eldest son David is also a pilot and musician. He is the guitarist and founder of rock band The Dead Daisies.

name: Vyacheslav Kim
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: Vyacheslav Kim is chairman of Kaspi Bank, Kazakhstan's largest payments and fintech company.
Kaspi's 2020 IPO was celebrated as London's largest international tech public offering that year .
Kaspi generated revenues of $2.5 billion in 2024.
Kim's partner at Kaspi is Georgian billionaire Mikhail Lomtadze, a former private equity investor at Russian-focused fund Baring Vostock.

name: Edythe Broad
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); Wikidata (2025)
forbes_bio: Edythe Broad is an American art collector and philanthropist.
She was married to billionaire businessman Eli Broad from 1954 until his death in 2021.
Known for their philanthropy, Edythe and Eli established two foundations that support medical research, public education and the visual and performing arts.
The foundations, which have been awarding grants for over 50 years, have pledged or given away more than $4 billion to date.

name: Mario Verrocchi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Mario Verrocchi opened the first Chemist Warehouse pharmacy store with brothers Jack Gance and Sam Gance in 2000.
Today it has over 600 outlets across Australia, New Zealand, China, Dubai and Ireland.
Chemist Warehouse dropped its IPO plan in favour of a merger with ASX-listed Sigma Healthcare, which was completed in February 2025.
Verrocchi bought a A$40 million historic seaside mansion in 2020.

name: Jamshyd Godrej
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2012-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun India (2015-2022)
forbes_bio: Jamshyd Godrej is chairman of the Godrej Enterprises Group, a conglomerate in Mumbai, which he controls with his sister, Smita Crishna-Godrej, also a billionaire.
The flagship of the Godrej Enterprises Group is privately held consumer goods giant Godrej & Boyce, which makes everything from locks to refrigerators.
His niece Nyrika Holkar is an executive director.at Godrej & Boyce and tipped to succeed him.
His son Navroze and niece Freyan Crishna Bieri have board seats at Godrej & Boyce.
forbes_facts: He is the cousin of the Godrej clan's billionaire patriarch Adi Godrej.
A U.S.-trained mechanical engineer, Jamshyd is a keen sailor.

name: David Blitzer
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: David Blitzer runs the tactical opportunities group at alternative investment giant Blackstone.

In 2011, he joined forces with then Apollo colleague Josh Harris to buy the NBA's Philadelphia 76ers. They later added the NHL's New Jersey Devils and English soccer club Crystal Palace to their holdings.
Blitzer also owns stakes in MLB's Cleveland Guardians, and he retained a minority stake in Real Salt Lake and the Utah Royals after the Miller Sports Group purchased a majority of the team in 2025.
Blitzer joined Harris' ownership group that purchased the NFL's Washington Commanders for $6.05 billion in 2023.
Blitzer graduated magna cum laude from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School.
